title: Adventures with days and months
summary: Practise the days of the week and the months of the year with fun challenges.
keyIdeas: A week has 7 days, from Monday to Sunday.
A year has 12 months and begins in January.
A calendar helps us plan our daily activities.

basicKnowledge: B. Sentido de la medida › Magnitud
B. Sentido de la medida › Medición

activities.prompt: How many days are in a whole week?
activities.explanation: A whole week always has 7 days, from Monday to Sunday.
activities.hint: Count: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

activities.prompt: Put these days of the week in order, from first to last.
activities.explanation: The school week begins on Monday and continues to Friday.

activities.prompt: In a usual week with classes from Monday to Friday, match each group of days to its name.
activities.explanation: In this week, school is from Monday to Friday. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

activities.prompt: Choose the word that completes the sentence.
activities.explanation: The year always begins on 1 January.
activities.hint: It is the month when Spain celebrates Three Kings' Day.
activities.sentence: The first month of every year is ___.

activities.prompt: A year has 10 months in total.
activities.explanation: A year has 12 months, from January to December.

activities.prompt: Sort each word into its group.
activities.explanation: Tuesday, Friday and Sunday are days. May, August and October are months.

activities.prompt: Hugo lists these days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Wednesday, Friday. What mistake does he make?
activities.explanation: Wednesday comes before Thursday. Hugo has swapped them.
activities.hint: Think about the day just after Tuesday.
options: He says a month instead of a day.

activities.prompt: Today is Tuesday. Lucía's birthday is in 3 days. Which day will it be?
activities.explanation: Count 3 days forwards from Tuesday: Wednesday (1), Thursday (2), Friday (3).
activities.hint: Count three days forwards from Tuesday.

activities.prompt: Aisha goes skating on Saturdays and Sundays. How many days does she skate in two weeks?
activities.explanation: She skates on 2 days each week. In two weeks, that is 2 + 2 = 4 days.
activities.hint: Add the two days in the first week to the two days in the second week.

activities.prompt: Put the first four months of the year in order.
activities.explanation: The first four months are January, February, March and April.
